"'''The Vault'''" was the headquarters of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. It was cut into the rock of [[Blackwind Crater]] on [[Saleucami/Legends|Saleucami]] and contained at least 30 pirates at any one time.<ref name="Mask of the Pirate Queen" />
